results.title: Telephone presentation and time management
results.brief_description: As a medium for information exchange, the telephone is constantly evolving, and so too are the techniques we use to make this powerful tool work for us in the business community. It’s important that we master these techniques. This video aims to improve your presentation and time management with the telephone in terms of your voice (variations in tone, pitch and volume), spelling out difficult names or numbers, good listening, mood, techniques for putting callers at ease and etiquette for receiving business calls using “hold” options and note taking.

results.title: Telephone etiquette
results.brief_description: Telephone etiquette is vitally important in ensuring effective information flow. results.title: Teiva
results.creator_credit: Francis Maziere, Theodora Olembert, Edition Francaise Cinematographique and Triangle Film Productions
results.brief_description: An important day in the life of a Tahitian boy, Teiva, living on the island of Bora Bora. He begins his day by seeing his father off on a fishing expedition, explores the waters close to the island, then sets off in his canoe across the lagoon to a volcanic island on the other side. He has set himself the task of climbing the high mountain on the island and returning before nightfall as a test of his manhood. He succeeds and returns home tired but contented.

results.title: Teine Samoa: a girl of Samoa
results.creator_credit: John Anderson, Dave Gibson and Gibson Film Productions

results.title: Teeth: their structure and care
results.brief_description: Explains the structure of teeth pointing out why they decay and the need for proper care. Dave is not fussy about his teeth and visits the dentist only when he has recurring toothache. The dentist explains the function of the different types of teeth in the mouth, the structure of a tooth and the ways in which decay begins and spreads. The film concludes by stressing the importance of eating proper foods, brushing the teeth regularly and consulting a dentist frequently.
